learnings: Technical errors (API failures, parsing issues) should be distinguished from analytical inconclusiveness in verdict reporting
For -bin packages with pinned checksums from official upstream sources, the audit is straightforward and models should confidently mark as safe when no injection patterns are present
The tool should implement retry logic or fallback models when API errors occur to prevent unnecessary escalations
Models should be trained to recognize standard Electron/Chromium packaging patterns (like chrome-sandbox setuid) as normal rather than flagging them for review
